decision: Keep the connected TX layout as the integration base; do not adopt its primary protection unchanged. Prioritize clamp trigger/rail response from the wired powered-peer initial bias. Area funding alone would not close the protection issue.
scope: Diagnostic 2ns current pulses with retained peer and ideal supply waveform; no ESD rating or inferred device damage threshold.

feedforward_candidate.decision: Do not adopt on peak reduction alone. Complete primary-to-core protection coordination; feed-forward alone does not establish a safe terminal envelope.
feedforward_candidate.physical_scope: Extracted standalone MIM attached to combined TX extraction; capacitor placement and connecting routes not integrated.
remaining_checks: Core terminal voltage-duration limits and coordinated secondary protection
Cold startup and powered-peer initial conditions
Distributed routing resistance and current capacity
Combined capacitor placement and extraction if selected
